rule: Read live sheet names, headers, candidate IDs, task IDs, asset IDs, owners and validations before every write; update by identity, not cached row numbers.

task_scope.include: Development or modification of a specific plugin asset: new implementation, porting, feature changes, bug fixes and version upgrades.
task_scope.exclude: Pure repository maintenance: rules or license-policy documents, generic templates, packaging tools, CI, tracker structure and repository initialization.
task_scope.maintenance_record: Record changes, validation and review in the GitHub PR only. Do not create development tasks, progress reports or pending tracker-sync records, or update candidates or the asset ledger for pure maintenance.
task_scope.mixed_pr: Track only the actual plugin-asset development or modification; do not create a separate task for accompanying repository maintenance.
task_scope.review_record: Candidate review updates Plugin Candidates only. Do not create a Development Task or Progress Report for inventory screening. Start plugin task tracking when the user selects an asset for implementation.

completion_gates: explicit user test-completion confirmation for the current version and final ZIP SHA-256, with known blocking issues resolved
explicit Project Lead acceptance of the GitHub handoff
linked development task/candidate/report readback verification; Asset Ledger registration is separate
linked candidate owners, task IDs and delivery state synchronized when applicable

asset_identity.hub_id: record real Hub ID in delivery.json; never invent one
asset_identity.pre_hub_storage: Repository and linked task/candidate/report records only; no Asset Ledger entry before successful Hub submission.

linkage.multiple_tasks: Keep all linked task IDs; preserve the explicitly assigned candidate lead.

ownership.authority: Explicit controller assignment or confirmed task assignment; never infer from AI account or PR author.
ownership.candidate_to_task: On an explicitly selected or continued task, inherit its confirmed candidate lead. General screening skips claimed candidates; never take over another owner without explicit handoff.
ownership.task_to_candidate: Fill an unassigned candidate from its confirmed primary task owner.
ownership.conflict: Check explicit assignment/handoff evidence; otherwise preserve both values and report the conflict.
ownership.handoff: Update both sheets and log old owner, new owner, date and authority in the progress report.
ownership.concurrency: Re-read by stable IDs before writing; batch linked updates and verify by readback.

state_rules.To Evaluate: A candidate or owner-only claim; no formal development task yet.
state_rules.Planned: A linked development task exists; first delivery is still open.
state_rules.Deferred: Controller explicitly defers the candidate; retain linked task history.
state_rules.Excluded: Explicit controller rejection, or confirmed complete functional coverage recorded by the candidates agent for an unclaimed candidate with no linked development task. Preserve evidence and history; task cancellation alone is insufficient.
state_rules.Delivered: Contributor first-delivery gates and explicit Project Lead acceptance of the GitHub handoff passed; linked task/candidate/report records were synchronized. Hub submission and Asset Ledger registration are separate. Track later upgrades in separate tasks.

candidate_workflow.evidence: Test-evidence links stay in the linked development task; record merged PR, version, asset ID and GitHub handoff status in candidate notes. Synchronize real Hub information only when supplied by Song Haoran.
candidate_workflow.not_applicable: Independent plugin requirements may have no candidate. Pure repository maintenance skips candidate and task tracking entirely; do not invent either record.
candidate_workflow.restore_rule: Never overwrite live claims, owners, statuses, links or notes with the initial import snapshot.

language_rule: Write all tracker descriptions, notes, progress reports, labels and statuses in English. Preserve stable IDs, owner names, URLs, versions, dates and exact original source filenames. Read live headers and dropdown options before each write; translated snapshots must never overwrite newer collaborative edits.

workflow.routing: Review ends with candidates for user selection. Explicit selection starts Build. Explicit completion of user testing for the current package starts Submit when known blocking issues are resolved.

review.skip_confirmed_duplicates: Skip Already Covered or an explicit complete-coverage conclusion without repeating upstream downloads or functional review. Reopen only for explicit user re-review or a new requested scope/version.
review.skip_claimed: During general screening skip a named Owner, an explicit selection/reservation, linked task IDs, or Planned/Delivered. Also skip Deferred/Excluded. Do not overwrite another claim.
review.compare: Compare historical and new assets across types, especially Skills, SwarmSkills and Plugins, by inputs, actions, outputs, scope, exclusions and dependencies. Start with tags and related details. Also inspect relevant active/completed development tasks, claims and merged PRs for capabilities not yet registered in Asset Ledger because Hub submission is pending.

confirmed_duplicate.condition: Only if still unclaimed and without linked development tasks at pre-write readback; otherwise preserve active work and report the conflict.

review.evidence: Record candidate version/ref, compared Asset IDs and versions, functional reasoning and actual review date in English.

build.trigger: User explicitly selects a candidate for migration/development, or explicitly continues an existing assigned task.
build.unknown_owner: Keep Unassigned; Planned, linked task IDs and a dated user-selection note still reserve the candidate.
build.concurrency: Re-read the candidate, ownership and linked task before writing. Batch linked candidate/task updates where possible and verify both. Repair partial writes before implementation; do not pretend this provides atomic compare-and-set locking.
build.review_reuse: Reuse existing review evidence and check relevant asset changes since that review rather than rescanning the complete catalog.
build.output: Native source and a Hub-format test package with version, ZIP SHA-256, actual tests, installation instructions, expected results and known issues.

submit.gate: Explicit user test completion for this Task ID, version and final ZIP SHA-256; known blocking issues resolved. Automated tests, CI, downloads, starting tests or a screenshot alone are insufficient.

required_content: faithful English rendering of actual user confirmation
actual conversation reference when available; never invent URLs
confirmation_record.example: User test confirmation: Testing is complete; confirmed by <actual user>; date/time <time>; Task ID <id>; version <version>; ZIP SHA-256 <hash>; known blocking issues <none/resolved details>; source <actual conversation reference or current conversation>.

submit.reuse_confirmation: Continue normal submission after a valid explicit confirmation without asking for the same approval again.
submit.invalidate_confirmation: A change to the tested payload, package wrapper or final ZIP requires testing and confirmation of the new package. Unrelated repository documentation that leaves the package unchanged does not invalidate it.
sequence: verify current package and user confirmation
verify tests, CI and distribution evidence
merge ZIP and verify actual merge
attach original test screenshots to the delivery PR and verify evidence permalinks
sync linked development task, candidate and report records; leave Asset Ledger unchanged
hand off merged release path, version, hash, installation notes and test evidence to the Project Lead
obtain explicit final Project Lead acceptance
mark Completed/Delivered only when contributor completion gates pass
submit.final_acceptance: User test completion is distinct from final Project Lead Acceptance. Only explicit acceptance by Song Haoran permits Accepted for the GitHub handoff; Hub submission/publication and its screenshot are not contributor acceptance prerequisites. Asset Ledger registration is also outside contributor completion gates.
submit.legacy_tasks: Preserve already merged PRs and historical progress. Never invent prior user confirmation; new package versions must meet the test-completion gate. Do not resubmit an identical already merged ZIP. Pending Project Lead-owned Hub work does not block contributor completion.

workflow.maintenance_exception: Pure repository maintenance uses a maintenance PR only; plugin user-test confirmation, ZIP/evidence gates, plugin task/report registration and candidate/asset updates do not apply.

access.connection_note: Link-based editing permission does not configure agent connector/API authentication. Use a configured Google Drive/Sheets connector or an available authorized browser route. Do not request an individual editor grant merely because a connector is unconfigured.
access.failure_rule: If no working route is available, report the actual connection/access blocker. For actual plugin work, preserve pending synchronization records; never claim the cloud sheet was updated without readback.

hub_ownership.scope: Agentic Hub submission, publication and associated Hub evidence are handled personally by the Project Lead.
hub_ownership.contributor_rule: Contributors and their agents deliver tested Hub-compatible packages through GitHub. Do not perform Hub operations or ask contributors to do them.
hub_ownership.completion_rule: Hub actions, review results and Hub screenshots are outside contributor completion gates. Preserve any real existing Hub evidence. Asset Ledger updates occur only after verified Hub submission success and are outside contributor completion gates.

screenshot_evidence.storage: Original full-resolution images attached to the delivery PR body or dedicated evidence comments.
screenshot_evidence.tracker_values: Evidence permalinks only in both screenshot columns; no embedded images, IMAGE formulas, local paths, base64, temporary signed image URLs or Drive links.
screenshot_evidence.test: Proactively request missing or invalid original test screenshots when the user reports testing complete. Verify actual images and task/version before writing links.
screenshot_evidence.hub: Agentic Hub Submission Screenshot is reserved for actual evidence supplied by Song Haoran; leave blank until available. Do not ask contributors to supply it.
screenshot_evidence.completion: Accessible real test evidence is required; Hub evidence is not a prerequisite for Completed/Delivered.
screenshot_evidence.legacy: Preserve old evidence until originals are safely attached to an allowed delivery PR and replacement links verified.

table_row_maintenance.rule: Extend existing native tables and linked filter ranges to include appended rows; preserve column types, dropdown choices/chips, date formats, wrapping and alignment.
table_row_maintenance.copy: Copy formatting only from a valid nearby row without copying values or hyperlinks. Preserve valid new owner choices.
table_row_maintenance.verify: Read back values and table coverage after writing; never leave new entries outside the table.

asset_ledger_registration.trigger: Verified successful Agentic Hub submission of the corresponding merged/tested asset version, performed personally by Song Haoran.
asset_ledger_registration.before_trigger: Do not append placeholders, register GitHub-only deliveries, or advance existing ledger versions/descriptions/sources/dates after PR merge. Keep internal IDs and progress in repository/task/candidate/report records.
asset_ledger_registration.success: A real Hub submission receipt, record or screenshot confirms acceptance of the matching asset/version payload. Submitted - Pending Review qualifies; publication/approval is not required.
asset_ledger_registration.write: After verified Hub submission success, match stable IDs/source URLs, update the existing asset for upgrades or append a New Asset row, preserve Historical Asset cohort and stable IDs, then verify by readback.
asset_ledger_registration.identity: Use the actual Hub ID/detail URL when available. If the accepted submission lacks a public ID/URL, identify repo:<type>:<slug> as internal and link verified submission evidence on the delivery PR; record the real Hub reference/status in linked reports/candidate notes.
asset_ledger_registration.follow_up: Synchronize original task/candidate/report links and real Hub evidence. Do not create a duplicate plugin task or reopen accepted contributor work solely for later ledger registration.
